positions.title: Operating Systems (CSE 451) Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
I've been a teaching assistant for in-major courses for the past 3 years.

6 times I TA-ed CSE333 - Systems Programming, where I:

• Taught sections that covered material about C, C++, system calls, networking, threads, processes and more
• Assisted students in figuring out the issues in their projects
• Created test questions to test the knowledge of the material
• Graded material for correctness

I've also TA-ed Computer Networks, Intro to Digital Design, and for my last quarter Operating Systems, each one quarter.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Outlook Mobile Team. I worked on 2 projects during my time here:
1. Refactoring feature configuration changes from code on the server front end to a configuration file stored in DocumentDB that is dynamically cached every minute for the latest change in Python code. This allowed feature changes to be active within seconds as opposed to having developers write code, get it approved, and wait for it to deploy. Additionally this involved the creation of an internal tool with a UI written in Groovy and ReactJS. This helps the mobile developers test their changes on their device more easily and provides a faster mechanism for rollout/rollback of features.
2. Worked on a testing framework specific to the server front end for test cases that, using Python tools like decorators, facilitates testing of behavior.

positions.title: SDE Intern
positions.description:
• Wrote mobile application for iOS and Android platforms using Swift/Objective-C and Java for monitoring the health of the AWS Simple Notification Service
• Implemented additional functionality to the existing health monitoring system in Java to provide support for the new frameworks
• Utilized various AWS services and APIs for Java/Android/iOS including EC2, SNS, SQS, DynamoDB, Cognito and Mobile SDK

projects.title: Bible App Development Project
projects.description:
MOTIVATION
As a Christian, I find it disappointing that I have not been able to find a Bible app in the Play Store nor App Store that meets all my needs. I end up using 3 or 4 different apps to do something I believe could be united in one glorious Bible app. This led me towards envisioning an app with everything I needed from a Bible (possibly one to finally replace my physical Bible), as well as one that others would benefit from and grow spiritually from.

VISION
To provide the best user experience for accessing a Bible, searching it, sharing it, and studying it to great depths.

SKILLS INVOLVED
Some of the skills involved to complete this project include:
 - Advanced Android/iOS/Web Development
 - Database Programming / Data Management
 - Cloud Computing
 - Indexing
 - Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence
 - UI Design Development
 - more...

Language-specifically, this project involves code in Java or Kotlin, XML, Objective-C or Swift, Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and more. The plan at the moment is to use a managed app service like Heroku or App Engine and use other cloud services for storing static and dynamic data.

CURRENT STATUS
Approximately 6% of the project is complete (core functionality in Android rolled out for Beta testing on the Play Store), and I'm considering refactoring many pieces of it to make it more space efficient, more memory efficient, and more robust in general. Development on this project has been paused as of 2017 and I'm not sure when I'll continue yet.
